about.title: About Lawrence Private Collection
about.sub: The world's trophy homes, published openly — and the ones that are not, kept for members.
about.ruleBody: Lawrence lists exceptional property from roughly €20 million. Below that line the inventory is someone else's business; above it, the market is fragmented across brokerages that are slow, badly structured and invisible to search. We publish it properly: full photography, real facts, sourced market data.
about.dataBody: Some sellers at this level prefer the market not to know. Those properties are held off-market: never indexed, never in a sitemap, visible only to members with a confirmed email address — full detail, treated as confidential. The account is free because the honesty is the point: real inventory converts better than artificial scarcity.
about.agenciesBody: Lawrence lists trophy property from specialist agents and directly from owners, openly or with discretion. Enquiries go to you, your mandate stays yours, and every listing above the line is published with the care it deserves.
